name: Hadaka Shitsuji ~Yarashitsuji & Yasashitsuji~
original_name: 裸執事ファンディスク～やらしつじ＆やさしつじ～
source:
[b]On the Spice side, everything's coming up Tomoaki![/b]

Somehow or other, Tomoaki became the true master of the Kamishiro estate, rather than just serving in the role as a part-time job. Bit by bit, he's been learning how to conduct himself and perform his duties as head of house. It's been a very busy time for him, but finally he gets one precious week off. Who will he spend it with and how?

It's a return to the spicy do-whatever-you-want life of master!

[b]On the Sugar side, enjoy a sweet life with a former butler.[/b]

Rather than returning to his old life when his time as part-time master ends, the time he spent at the estate drastically changed the course of his life and that of one of his butlers. Enjoy these bitter-sweet "what if" tales of former master and former butler as they've developed a relationship that's more than friendship, but not quite love, continuing each of the butlers' "romantic" endings from the original game.

[Edited from [url=https://mangagamer.org/spiceandsugar/]MangaGamer[/url]]
